turns: 8; I added `e2e/api/generated/REV-07.spec.ts` with one test, tagged `@REV-07`. The API test passes, and `npx tsc --noEmit` printed no errors. No other file was changed.

The test is "An expired insurance certificate cannot be approved". It creates a vendor with a W-9 and a contract through the factory, then uploads an insurance certificate whose expiry date is yesterday (UTC). It waits for extraction, submits the vendor, and has a reviewer approve the certificate's extraction. The assertion is only that the status is below 500, as you specified, with no check on 409 or `insurance_expired`.

Two choices to review:
- **Inline upload instead of the factory's expired sample.** The shipped `samples/insurance_certificate.txt` expires in 2027, and I couldn't add a sample file. So the spec builds the certificate text itself. The factory has no way to take a custom buffer, so this part of the arrange is inline in the spec.
- **No stored-state check after the approve call.** I left out a re-read of the extraction status. The expiry check is flaky, so a check on the stored status could fail intermittently.
